rows.text: The Mirror Holders created all manner of bizarre rituals, all in pursuit of the ideal of Beauty in their hearts. To Talorensky, beauty means "devotion." He placed the fragments of the Mirror of Transcendence into a fragile soap bubble — the foam a symbol of his inner thoughts, embarking on his pilgrimage. When the bubble bursts from the ardor of the journey, he would return to the garden of his home and reseal the mirror in the bubble. Each time he would return, and each time he would depart, never stepping foot off the home planet to this day. But to those who asked, he would resolutely mention his destination — where Idrila, the Aeon of Beauty fell: The Consternation Starzone, Lafcadio.
